summarize_circleci_workflow: summarize test results from a CircleCI workflow given a workflow_id argument
collect_job_test_failures: collect and aggregate test failures across all jobs in a CircleCI workflow
generate_failure_summary_by_test: generate a failure summary grouped by normalized test name with error counts
generate_failure_summary_by_model: generate a failure summary grouped by model name with associated failing tests
download_and_parse_test_artifacts: download test summary artifacts from CircleCI jobs and parse passed/failed results into JSON
